clients.description: Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration for Banglalink Digital: ~1 TB of data, 550+ tables and 1,700+ database objects.
clients.body:
## What I Did

- Migrated ~1 TB of production data, 550+ tables, 1,700+ stored procedures/database objects and 23 application projects from Oracle to PostgreSQL.
- Redesigned cross-database integration and built an executable validation loop to verify the migration.
- Built O2P, a data-migration tool for moving large, changing production datasets reliably.

## Proof of Work

Migration plan repository and tooling.

clients.description: Employer hiring system, SkillMatch Score and a CQRS search pipeline for Bdjobs.com.
clients.body:
## Engagement

**Jr. Software Engineer** at **Bdjobs.com Ltd.**, May 2023 – March 2024.

## What I Did

- Helped migrate the Bdjobs.com corporate panel from legacy ASP to Angular and ASP.NET Core.
- Developed the Employers Job Posting and Hiring System and the Candidate SkillMatch Score.
- Implemented a CQRS-style architecture with an ETL pipeline separating read/write databases for job listings.

## Impact

- Platform sales up 17% from the new hiring features.
- Search efficiency improved by 30% after query optimization and the CQRS split.

clients.description: Software engineering for FirstTrip's OTA platform: flight search, supplier integrations and booking automation.
clients.body:
## Engagement

Through **TechnoNext Software Ltd.** (concern of US-Bangla Group) as **Software Engineer**, April 2024 – present. FirstTrip runs on the shared multi-tenant OTA platform I work on; I am listed as a developer on the FirstTrip project.

## What I Did

- Built and maintained the shared multi-tenant OTA platform (B2B & B2C) this brand runs on — part of a 36+ service ecosystem serving 6 OTA clients.
- Delivered 8 cloud-native supplier integrations (Sabre, Travelport, Travelport NDC, Air India, Flydubai, SQ NDC, TK NDC, IndiGo), increasing flight search feed by 27%.
- Implemented Progressive Search, Search Ranking, Universal Split PNR, Refund Reissue and PNR Details.
- Built the Booking Cancellation Service (ASP.NET Core + Hangfire) that cancels un-ticketed bookings before the last ticketing time.
- Built an xUnit API integration test suite for 30+ supplier integrations, and integrated APM with Elasticsearch structured logging.

## Impact

- ADM penalties reduced by $4,500–$6,400 per month per OTA (~$23K–$27K saved across 6 clients).
- Production failure rate cut by 30% after APM + structured logging.
- Flight search feed up 27% from new supplier integrations.

## Proof of Work

FirstTrip project membership in the company PMS, plus screens of the shared platform and the Booking Cancellation Service.
clients.name: FirstTrip
